rebar:1c39-96d4-8f9e-4d38 (OPEN, discovered_from eb6e): "A Gerrit change is neither a pull_request nor a push to main ... the Verified +1 a change needs ... carries NO signal about whether its terraform was applied"; the 34cd alarm "was itself invisible: declared in HCL, absent from CloudWatch"
monitoring_eb6e.tf is authored in a SEPARATE Gerrit change (safety-net change 1326), not in these two changed files — the test manufactures confidence that the backstop exists
advisory.finding: The new drift test (and the compose comment at lines 183-185) assert the review-bot's Bedrock ids match monitoring_eb6e.tf's ModelId dimensions at the HCL/text level, which proves the alarm's config matches but NOT that the alarm is actually applied to CloudWatch. Per the OPEN, filed bug 1c39 (discovered_from this cutover ticket), terraform-drift never runs pre-submit on a Gerrit change, so the coupled alarm can land as un-applied HCL; combined with the cutover's deliberate no-cross-provider-fallback, the intended client-error backstop for this flip's blast radius could be absent while both gates read green.
